rules: Preserve approved x/y coordinates exactly; projection never rewrites plan geometry.
Treat wall polygons as one even-odd wall topology, not independent solid polygons.
Use the aperture registry to classify wall gaps as windows or doors.
Do not fill a registered door aperture when extruding walls.
For registered windows, add provisional sill/lintel/glass geometry rather than leaving a floor-to-ceiling gap.
Window and door z dimensions are provisional and may change without altering aperture x/y spans.
Render floor-plane rugs as underlays beneath furniture; they must never visually clip objects sitting on them.
Model the bedroom bed as a lower base/mattress plus a separate west-wall headboard rather than one tall solid prism.
PC tower is physically under the desk in z-space.
Microwave is physically above the stove/oven in z-space.
Model the shower as a low tray plus enclosure edges, not one solid block.
Model the toilet with contained tank/pedestal/bowl sub-shapes inside its approved footprint; do not extrude the whole top-down oval into the shower divider.
Treat kitchen pendants as suspended overhead objects; their plan projection must not be mistaken for sink hardware.
Camera yaw/pitch may change only after topology and z-model sanity validation passes.
sanity_gate: Bedroom door remains in the approved location.
Living chair/couch/TV relationships match the top-down plan.
Registered windows remain semantic apertures rather than missing or filled walls.
White chair sits on the living rug and the rug stops before the couch.
Closet opening is treated as a double/folding door, not an anonymous wall gap.
White chair remains fully visible above the living rug underlay.
Toilet remains visually clear of the shower divider and vanity.
Pendant pair is distributed symmetrically along the island long axis.
No camera candidate is valid if it makes approved room/opening/object relationships appear to move or rotate.
